name: week
title: Review response desk
subtitle: Synthetic demo records. Imported snapshots, not a live platform feed.

sections.title: Responses to prepare
sections.sql: select location,external_id as review,rating,owner,due_on,overdue_days,next_step from v_response_queue order by overdue_days desc,location,external_id

sections.title: Location health
sections.sql: select code as location,reviews,awaiting_response,overdue,low_rating_open,imported_average from v_location_health order by code
sections.note: Average and counts cover imported records only. They are not the live platform rating.

sections.title: Service actions
sections.sql: select l.code location,a.title,a.owner,a.due_on,a.status from actions a join reviews r on r.id=a.review_id join locations l on l.id=r.location_id order by due_on

name: integrity
title: Review integrity and privacy checks
subtitle: Recorded checks for a human review. No finding establishes whether a review is genuine.

sections.title: Evidence needing attention
sections.sql: select location,rule,issue from v_compliance order by location,rule

sections.title: Export coverage
sections.sql: select code,latest_export from v_location_health order by code
